definitions.explanation: Informal conversation on random topics, not focused on any particular subject or purpose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{休憩時間|きゅうけいじかん}→休憩時間：16113_kyuukeijikan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{同僚|どうりょう}→同僚：01023_douryou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{雑談|ざつだん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I chatted with my coworker during the break.

examples.japanese: {雑談|ざつだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧。
examples.english: We got excited chatting about random things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧{雑談|ざつだん}⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's stop talking about work and just chat.

notes:
FORMS:
{雑|ざつ} (miscellaneous, various) + {談|だん} (talk, conversation) → miscellaneous talk

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {雑談|ざつだん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to chat, to have small talk)
- {雑談|ざつだん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{盛|も}り{上|あ}がる→盛り上がる：06344_moriagaru⟧ (to get excited chatting)
- {雑談|ざつだん}{力|りょく} (ability to make small talk - a valued social skill)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{世間話|せけんばなし}→世間話：07021_sekenbanashi⟧ (small talk) - more about everyday topics, news
- ⟦おしゃべり→お喋り：01911_oshaberi⟧ (chatting) - more casual, often longer conversations
- {雑談|ざつだん} - general casual talk, often in work/formal settings
- ⟦{井戸端|いどばた}{会議|かいぎ}→井戸端会議：07402_idobatakaigi⟧ (gossip session) - informal neighborhood gossip

USAGE:
{雑談|ざつだん} is neutral and often used in workplace contexts. {雑談|ざつだん}{力|りょく} (small talk skills) is considered an important social skill in Japanese business culture for building relationships.
